pictures.scene: Vincent van Gogh, Starry Night Over the Rhone — the great field of stars burning over the dark river and the lights of the town, For the choirmaster, a Psalm of David; the heavens declare the glory of God
pictures.name: pd_vangogh_rhone

pictures.scene: Jacob van Ruisdael, View of Haarlem with Bleaching Grounds — an enormous sky of moving cloud standing over the small fields and town below, the skies proclaim the work of His hands, day after day they pour forth speech
pictures.name: pd_ruisdael_haarlem

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Two Men Contemplating the Moon — two figures standing still in the dusk with the moon before them, night after night they reveal knowledge, without speech or language
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_moon

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Among the Sierra Nevada Mountains — a silent lit valley under cloud and peaks with no voice in it at all, without a sound to be heard, their voice has gone out into all the earth
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_sierra

pictures.scene: Claude Lorrain, A Seaport at Sunrise — the sun standing low over the water and the harbour reaching away to the horizon, their words to the ends of the world; in the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun
pictures.name: pd_lorrain_sunrise

pictures.scene: Lavinia Fontana, The Wedding Feast at Cana — the marriage table with the bridegroom among his guests, like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course
pictures.name: pd_fontana_cana

pictures.scene: Albert Bierstadt, Sunrise, Yosemite Valley — the first light coming over the cliffs and flooding the whole valley, it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other
pictures.name: pd_bierstadt_sunrise

pictures.scene: Camille Pissarro, The Harvest, Pontoise — reapers working in full summer heat in an open field, nothing is deprived of its warmth; the Law of the LORD is perfect
pictures.name: pd_pissarro_harvest

pictures.scene: Philippe de Champaigne, Moses Presenting the Tablets of the Law — Moses holding out the two tablets of stone, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy
pictures.name: pd_champaigne_moses

pictures.scene: Gerrit Dou, Portrait of an Old Woman Reading a Bible — an old woman bent over the open page in a quiet room, making wise the simple; the precepts of the LORD are right
pictures.name: pd_dou_reader

pictures.scene: Pompeo Batoni, The Return of the Prodigal Son — the father taking his son into his arms again, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant
pictures.name: pd_batoni_prodigal

pictures.scene: Georges de La Tour, Saint Joseph the Carpenter — the boy holding a candle so that its light falls on the working man's face, giving light to the eyes; the fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever
pictures.name: pd_latour_joseph

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Belshazzar's Feast — the king turning in terror as the hand writes the judgment on the wall, the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_belshazzar

pictures.scene: Konrad Witz, The Queen of Sheba before King Solomon — the queen bringing her gold and her gifts to the throne, they are more precious than gold, than much pure gold
pictures.name: pd_witz_sheba

pictures.scene: Juan van der Hamen, Still Life with Sweets and Pottery — boxes and dishes of sweetmeats set out on a stone ledge, they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb
pictures.name: pd_hamen_sweets

pictures.scene: Salvator Rosa, Jonah Preaching to the People of Niniveh — the prophet standing over the crowd with his arm raised in warning, by them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward
pictures.name: pd_rosa_jonah

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Denial of Saint Peter — Peter in the firelight pointing back at himself as he is accused, who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_denial

pictures.scene: Ivan Kramskoy, Christ in the Desert — Christ sitting alone on the stones at dawn through the long temptation, keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me
pictures.name: pd_kramskoy_desert

pictures.scene: Joachim Patinir, The Baptism of Christ — Christ standing in the Jordan with the dove descending and the Father above, then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression
pictures.name: pd_patinir_baptism

pictures.scene: Fritz von Uhde, The Mealtime Prayer — Christ speaking in a poor cottage while the family stands with bowed heads at the table, may the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
pictures.name: pd_uhde_prayer

pictures.scene: Thomas Moran, The Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone — the vast rock walls of the canyon standing in sunlight above the falls, be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer
pictures.name: pd_moran_canyon

lines.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
The heavens declare the glory of God;
the skies proclaim the work of His hands.
Day after day they pour forth speech;
night after night they reveal knowledge.
Without speech or language,
without a sound to be heard,
their voice has gone out into all the earth,
their words to the ends of the world.
In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.
Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber,
like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
it rises at one end of the heavens
and runs its circuit to the other;
nothing is deprived of its warmth.
The Law of the LORD is perfect,
reviving the soul;
the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy,
making wise the simple.
The precepts of the LORD are right,
bringing joy to the heart;
the commandments of the LORD are radiant,
giving light to the eyes.
The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever;
the judgments of the LORD are true,
being altogether righteous.
They are more precious than gold,
than much pure gold;
they are sweeter than honey,
than honey from the comb.
By them indeed Your servant is warned;
in keeping them is great reward.
Who can discern his own errors?
Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
Keep Your servant also from willful sins;
may they not rule over me.
Then I will be blameless
and cleansed of great transgression.
May the words of my mouth
and the meditation of my heart
be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD,
my Rock and my Redeemer.
